evidence_interpretation.narrative: A configuration-only advance on the published v0.6.5 component: source 696e78c7, image 5e3e1558 and binary b8a0a2c3 are unchanged, and the lifecycle configuration advances from 5eb8a557 to 762e6bf4 by raising the Host KV pool from 8 GiB to 16 GiB. Every gate above was measured on a candidate container started from the published image with the v0.7.0 arguments - prefill, decode, agent protocol, fanout at two template sizes, warm arrival in both orders, restore, and two 126K sessions keeping reuse - so nothing is inherited from the v0.6.10 configuration. The tamper arm is bound by reference to v0.6.10 because the binary is unchanged. The two-session durability row is a bounded finding, not a passing gate.
